justification: Both surfaces carry profile quadrupeds and swirling curvilinear/spiral marks, but these are the most generic possible correspondences: in A the spirals are a water convention within a coherent narrative of a chariot, wheeled vehicle, horses and swimming men, while B shows isolated schematic animals and abstract designs scattered independently across separate boulder faces. The manner of depiction also diverges sharply, A using modelled, anatomically detailed relief bodies in an ordered scene, B using flat schematic outline figures with no narrative linkage.
